rationale:
The `{cite}` role is right for `src/authoring/usage.rs#struct[UsageLog]`.

- **Not a test.** The item is a struct, so `{test}` does not apply.
- **Not an `{impl}` root.**
  - The struct only holds the in-memory `record: UsageRecord`, the record's file `path`, and timing and request-tracking state. It has no serialized form of its own.
  - The serialized fields the requirement lists live in `struct[UsageRecord]`. These include version, run, project root, subject, start and end time, outcome, determination, `evidence_output` and `evidence_written`.
  - The behavior that makes the decisions sits in `impl[UsageLog]`: `start` creates `<state>/authoring/usage/<run-id>.json`, `finish` sets the outcome, and `save` writes the file. The marked `{impl}` sites for this requirement are in `src/authoring/mod.rs`, which already reach `UsageLog` through what they call and the types they use.
  - So `UsageLog` is not an unreached root and needs no `{impl}`.
- **A `cite` fits.** The struct pairs one record with the file path of one per-run JSON usage record. Its `active_request` and `seen` fields support recording unfinished or cancelled runs without storing source text. A change to the requirement's text could require changing it. Examples are a change to where the record lives, to how a run is identified or kept separate, or to how unfinished runs are distinguished.
- **No redundancy.** The item has no `{impl}` or `{test}` reference to the same requirement, so the citation is not a duplicate. The commentary is empty and adds no context.

text: Each assessment MUST have a separate JSON usage record under
It MUST identify its format version, run, project root, subject kind and full
name, start time, backend and model when known, end time when finished, outcome,
accepted determination kind (`true`, `false`, or `FIXME`) when present, and
whether evidence was written. It MUST record the selected output destination in
`evidence_output` as `file` or `stdout`; a successful write to either destination
MUST set `evidence_written` to true. Usage recording MUST remain outside the
project in stdout mode. FIXME entry text MUST NOT be stored in usage records.
runs MUST remain distinguishable from completed judgments. Records MUST persist
for later review without storing source text, prompts, responses, or rationale.
